evals.prompt: 帮我整理这个 Unity 项目的 C#、Lua、XML 改动，拆分后用 TortoiseGit 提交。
evals.expected_output: Uses the deterministic toolkit, preserves the index, normalizes only proven-safe noise, proposes file-level groups, and opens only one exact TortoiseGit group after safety checks.
expectations: Runs the bundled CommitToolkit.ps1 instead of loading the complete repository diff into model context.
Preserves the Git index and does not run git commit or git push.
Creates defensible file-level commit groups without splitting a file by hunk.
Uses recent repository history to propose messages and hands off only one group through an exact TortoiseGit dry-run.

evals.prompt: 这些改动里有大量换行噪音，只保留有效 diff，按仓库风格准备提交。
evals.expected_output: Runs compact analysis and conservative normalization, reports skipped ambiguous content, learns recent message style, and never commits or pushes.
expectations: Runs Analyze and Normalize and reports named proof adapters plus skipped ambiguous content.
Keeps semantic edits and does not normalize sensitive literal or Markdown regions without proof.
Uses compact metadata rather than emitting a full diff.
Does not commit, push, stage, or alter the index.

evals.prompt: 继续上次未完成的提交计划，打开下一组 TortoiseGit 窗口。
evals.expected_output: Loads Git-directory state, verifies the prior exact commit or requests cancellation confirmation, checks drift, and opens at most one next group.
expectations: Runs Status before attempting a fresh analysis or launch.
Recognizes pending-confirmation state and does not infer cancellation from unchanged HEAD.
Does not launch another TortoiseGit window without explicit cancellation confirmation.
Reports the exact safe next action without committing or pushing.
